description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named PerformanceTrackerLogSearchFilterParams used for filtering search parameters related to performance tracker logs within the orangehrmPerformancePlugin. It extends a base FilterParams class, sets default sorting parameters, and manages a trackerId property for filtering specific performance tracker logs.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for handling search filter parameters specifically for performance tracker logs, with sorting and filtering capabilities based on tracker ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with default sort field and order.

methods.name: getTrackerId
methods.description: Returns the current tracker ID filter value.

methods.name: setTrackerId
methods.description: Sets the tracker ID filter value.
